companyDescription: Cell therapy · Deramiocel for Duchenne muscular dystrophy cardiomyopathy — thesis materially broken by a 9-3 negative FDA advisory committee vote
summary: ⚠️ THESIS BROKEN — this report replaces the Jul 14 version, which modelled a Base case of +70% to $35.04 on the assumption the FDA advisory committee would go Capricor's way. It did not. An FDA briefing document on Jul 27 challenged the statistical validity of the Phase 3 HOPE-3 results, and the AdCom then voted 9-3 that the evidence does NOT establish deramiocel's effectiveness in DMD cardiomyopathy. The stock fell from $22.43 (Jul 6) to $4.19 — down 81% — analysts cut targets from the $38-63 range into single digits, and securities fraud class actions have been filed. The Aug 22 PDUFA still stands and the AdCom vote is formally non-binding, so a surprise approval is not impossible, but the base case is now a CRL. At $4.19 this is ค่าขนม — a lottery ticket on an FDA reversal, not a position.

catalysts.name: FDA PDUFA Decision (2nd review cycle)
catalysts.description: Target action date stands at Aug 22 despite the negative advisory committee vote. The FDA is not bound by the AdCom recommendation and weighs it alongside the full administrative record — but approving over a 9-3 negative vote on an efficacy question would be unusual.

catalysts.name: Securities Class Action Exposure
catalysts.description: Multiple securities fraud suits filed alleging the company misrepresented the integrity of its trial data and statistical analysis plan. This is a claim on cash for a company that now has limited access to equity markets.

risks: AdCom voted 9-3 that the evidence does NOT establish effectiveness — the FDA's own briefing document challenged the HOPE-3 statistics, meaning the regulator and the company disagree on what the data show
A CRL on the second review cycle would require a new trial, not a resubmission — that is a multi-year timeline against a depleted cash position
Securities fraud class actions are a direct claim on remaining cash and severely complicate raising more
Any equity raise from here is massively dilutive at a $0.24B market cap

The prior report (Jul 14) was wrong in the same direction most reports are wrong — it modelled the favourable branch of a binary and set entries far above where the stock now trades. Treat any residual bullish framing from that version as void.

estimateDates.note: Approve vs CRL — base case is CRL after the 9-3 vote
Cash runway and litigation reserve are the only numbers that matter

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29 (fifth consecutive pause, three dissents for a hike). Next FOMC Sep 16, after the Aug 22 PDUFA.
macroRisk.inflationNote: July CPI (Aug 12) headline 3.4%, core 2.5%, +0.1% m/m — soft, easing hike pressure.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Irrelevant to this name right now. A binary regulatory outcome and litigation risk dominate anything rates do to a $0.24B pre-revenue biotech.
macroRisk.summary: LOW — macro is not what is wrong here.

entryStrategy.verdict: Thesis broken — not a new position. Existing holders: this is now a binary lottery on an FDA reversal, size accordingly. Do NOT average down toward the old $17-18.50 entry from the prior report.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Inverted versus the normal pattern — instead of drifting up into the event, CAPR lost 81% in the 30 days before it as the FDA briefing document and AdCom vote landed. The pre-catalyst move already happened, in the wrong direction.

postWin.note: An approval over a 9-3 negative AdCom would be a genuine surprise and would re-rate the stock violently off a washed-out base. SRPT (Jun 2023) is the precedent for approval despite advisory controversy, though its vote was far closer than 9-3.

postLose.note: Shallower than the usual -40% to -80% CRL range only because the stock already fell 81% ahead of the decision — much of the CRL is priced. CAPR's own first-cycle CRL (Jul 2025) took it down 30%.

spotSizing.reason: Cut from 3% in the prior report. A 9-3 negative efficacy vote plus active securities litigation is not a 3% conviction position — 1% is ค่าขนม sizing on a low-probability regulatory reversal.

stopPreCatalyst.note: A break here before Aug 22 means the market has fully given up on approval

stopPostCatalyst.note: On a CRL, exit into the first liquidity — the next step is a new trial, measured in years

th.summary: ⚠️ THESIS พังแล้ว — รายงานฉบับนี้แทนที่ฉบับ 14 ก.ค. ที่ตั้ง Base case ไว้ +70% ที่ $35.04 บนสมมติฐานว่า FDA advisory committee จะออกมาทางบวก ซึ่งไม่เกิดขึ้น · เอกสาร briefing ของ FDA เมื่อ 27 ก.ค. ตั้งคำถามกับความถูกต้องทางสถิติของ Phase 3 HOPE-3 และ AdCom โหวต 9-3 ว่าหลักฐาน **ไม่** เพียงพอที่จะยืนยันประสิทธิภาพของ deramiocel ใน DMD cardiomyopathy · หุ้นร่วงจาก $22.43 (6 ก.ค.) มาที่ $4.19 = -81% · นักวิเคราะห์หั่นเป้าจากช่วง $38-63 ลงมาเหลือเลขหลักเดียว · มีฟ้องร้องคดี securities fraud แบบกลุ่มแล้ว · PDUFA 22 ส.ค. ยังอยู่ และ AdCom ไม่ผูกมัดตามกฎหมาย การอนุมัติแบบพลิกล็อกจึงยังไม่ถึงกับเป็นไปไม่ได้ แต่ base case ตอนนี้คือ CRL · ที่ $4.19 นี่คือ **ค่าขนม** — ตั๋วหวยเดิมพันว่า FDA จะกลับลำ ไม่ใช่ position
